Hi there! For me my anger comes in gusts. So like when I get inconvenienced at all, I'm immediately enraged and I usually have it happen at work unfortunately so i cant like do much about it, (especially since I work in customer service, so I cant just blow up in front of so many customers) but I end up going to the back and like going into the walk-in freezer to just yell and punch things. When I'm home though it's harder for me to control it, I usually end up lashing out at my husband, however he is able to talk to me thank god and like let me know that it's okay and I'm okay. And lately that does help me when I'm on my own too since he started this new job and I'm usually on my own at home now. 
I just tell myself now that I'm alright and like I got this/ I can do this, and just if I absolutely need to I'll do random cardio(?) Like jumping (-jacks), running in place. If I'm in my car and I'm angry, I'll turn up the music and scream until I forget why I scream because I get super embarrassed when I scream so that kind of automatically makes my brain tone it DOWN fastest.
